Text: “My science teams have been cataloguing planetoids in {StarSystem}. They found something incredible!”

What looked like a ring-shaped asteroid orbiting {StarSystem} 4 is actually a man-made metal structure: a gigantic ring rotating to simulate gravity, presumably created by pre-Collapse scientists.

The megastructure is in ruins, but a few sections could be repaired.
We'll repair it when we have the resources, to house the commoners of {StarSystem}
We lack the means for this project, just scavenge what you can

They discover what’s left of a municipal hub, as well as the notes of the lead architect, one Tania Cavalcanti:

“Since the failure of Mars’ and Venus’ urban projects, life in space has been cramped and punishing. I was thrilled when the League accepted my proposal for a joint project with the Galileo Institute. This ringworld will redefine spacefaring life.”
This was a temple to cooperation
The ringworld inspires you to cooperate with others more
They were naive, and failed; I cannot let myself be so soft
You vow to remain strong, and not fall prey to such follies
Regardless of their intentions, their engineering is remarkable
The ringworld inspires you to study ancient engineering texts
People from across {Faction} flock to {StarSystem} to see the ringworld
A wonder from a distant past.
{StupidCharacter} tried, and failed, to construct a ringworld

{He(StupidCharacter)} will stop at nothing, and has sunk immense funds into the project.

{Character} shakes {his(Character)} head in bemusement. “This is why we don’t try to replicate the wonders of the past. A fool’s endeavour.”
{Techie} bursts into the council chamber: “The ringworld is making people sick!”

“I don’t know what’s causing it, but we’re getting horrendous reports: one in ten ringworld residents suffer from a bizarre fainting sickness. 

"They must evacuate!”
{Techie}, take a science team and fix this!
“I attempted to discover the cause of the ringworld sickness...”
"I was successful: the residents should recover soon. I'll explain more on my return."
"I discovered the cause, but to my shame I couldn’t resolve the problem.  I'll explain more on my return."
“I discovered reports of the ringworld’s last days: its gravitational forces caused severe illness. Cavalcanti, the architect, was baffled. Eventually the League forced her to scrap the project.
“I used her notes to recalibrate the gravitational forces to a standard post-Collapse orbital. Living offworld for centuries has some advantages.
The people of {StarSystem} have evacuated their homes on the ringworld
The ruined structure is silent once more: abandoned, perhaps for another three centuries.
“The cursed ringworld sickens us! Abandon it!”

A mob has formed in one of the colonies of {StarSystem}, demanding {houseOf(Ruler)} abandon the ringworld. They claim it is one of the scientific abominations that led to the Collapse.

“Frankly,” {d(Ruler)} sigh{s(Ruler)}, “this damn ringworld has caused enough trouble.”
I agree: leave the damn thing be
{PlayerHouse} will round up the ringleaders; the others will soon lose interest
Your peacekeepers round up the ringleaders, none too gently
The crowd disperses. The next day, the streets are silent.
But the crowd only chants louder. Scuffles break out, and the ringleaders are freed.
I’ll speak to them: the ringworld’s a blessing, not a curse
A murmur of agreement ripples across the crowd. Eventually they agree: the ringworld is a part of {StarSystem}, and it can serve us for the better.

The ringleaders shake their heads; a murmur runs through the crowd. They’re not convinced, but listen respectfully. 

The next day the crowd is smaller, but you fear this has not been settled.
Your words fall on deaf ears: in moments you are shouted down, and the ringleaders resume their chant.
"You turned down the chance to restore a ringworld. Now we'll never know what opportunities you squandered..."
A salvageable section of an enormous ring structure; as the ring rotates, people walking on the ring's interior experience simulated gravity.
